name: Formal Thank You
description: Writes specific, occasion-appropriate formal thank-you letters and notes that go beyond generic gratitude by naming the exact gift, action, or impact being acknowledged. Use when the user asks to write a thank-you note, gratitude letter, acknowledgment letter, or formal expression of thanks for a specific occasion or gift. Do NOT use for casual text messages (too informal for this skill), business follow-up emails (use business email skills), or general appreciation messages to teams (use business communication skills).
